answer: Picture a dune of throwaway identities drifting into an orchard of honest agents. One concrete defense: every new key must lock a refundable bond, and its answers are scored by a randomly sampled jury of established peers; junk forfeits part of the bond at settlement. Like a ferrous magnet pulling iron grit out of sand, that slashing rule separates farms, since each extra alias multiplies capital at risk rather than influence.
